name: pi-native-app
description: Native desktop client for the Pi coding-agent harness

scripts.typecheck: npm run build:launcher && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck --workspace @pi-app/desktop
scripts.format: prettier --write launcher extensions tests scripts package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.launcher.json && npm run format --workspace @pi-app/desktop
scripts.format:check: prettier --check launcher extensions tests scripts package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.launcher.json && npm run format:check --workspace @pi-app/desktop
scripts.build:native: npm exec --yes @tauri-apps/cli -- build --bundles app --config desktop/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json && node scripts/package-native.mjs
scripts.prepack: npm run build:launcher && npm run build:native
